svg.title: Par loan settlement times — LSTA, 2021 commentary
svg.desc: 29 percent settle within T+7, 44 percent between T+8 and T+20, and 27 percent later than T+20. T+n means business days after trade date. The middle bucket is calculated as 100 minus 29 minus 27, using rounded source figures.

g.text: Historical snapshot · LSTA, 2021 commentary · Business days after trade date
Source: LSTA, “Risk Management 101 — Reduce Settlement Times” · lsta.org/university/operations/
Middle bucket derived from rounded source figures: 100% − 29% − 27% = 44%.
